solves: Gives the person a form field that opens a panel with a tree, to choose one item or several from data in levels, such as folders, departments or categories, without leaving the form.
use_when: When the choice depends on the place of the item in a hierarchy: a destination folder, a department of a unit, a category with subcategories.
In single, when the form takes one item: one destination, one department, one category.
In search, when the tree is large and the person knows the name of the item; the search keeps the ancestors of every match.
In multiple, when the form takes several items or whole branches; checking a parent checks its children.
Inside an nph-field, which gives the label, the help text and the error message.
default in most forms; large when the form uses tall fields.
do_not_use_when: For a list with no levels: use nph-select or nph-combobox.
To explore and open items without filling a field: use nph-tree directly.
In multiple when the field takes one item only: use single.
With a panel narrower than the field of the mode: the labels and the indent of the levels do not fit.
Without the nph-field and a visible label: the placeholder goes away when a value is chosen.

mode.constraint: The Figma `modo`. single takes the field of the nph-select; search the field of the nph-combobox; multiple the field of the nph-multi-combobox, with chips. Reflects because the internal CSS reads it. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

size.constraint: The height of the field: control/height-default or control/height-large, as the nph-select. The panel and the items do not change with the size. Any other value draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

items.constraint: Property only. The nodes of the first level, as in nph-tree: id (unique), label, children, branch, disabled, loading and error. The list is replaced, not changed in place. A node with no id or label, a repeated id or children that is not a list draws nothing and emits console.error in development, once per cause.

expanded.constraint: Property only. The ids of the open branches. The person changes it, and so does the code; an event says what the person did. On opening, the path to the chosen item is added to it.

value.constraint: The id of the chosen item in single and search; empty for none. The value attribute is its default until the person or the code sets one. The field shows the label of the item, on one line with an ellipsis. Setting it from code fires no event.

values.constraint: Property only. The ids of the checked items in multiple. When a whole branch is checked it carries the parent and every enabled item under it, as checked of nph-tree does; the field shows one chip, the parent's. Setting it from code fires no event.

query.constraint: Property only. The text typed in search and multiple. Setting it from code filters the tree and fires no event. It is never a value: leaving the field and a choice clear it.

placeholder.constraint: The invitation before a choice, already localized. It hides with the first choice. It is not a name.

counter.constraint: In multiple, the field stays on one line and shows subject and an nph-badge with how many chips there are, instead of the chips.

subject.constraint: The subject of the field in counter mode, already localized, such as "Folders".

icons.constraint: The folder on a branch and the file on a leaf, in the tree of the panel.

loading.constraint: The first load: while items is empty, the panel shows the skeleton rows of the nph-tree and the tree is aria-busy.

remove-label.constraint: The word the remove button of each chip says before the item, already localized, such as "Remove". Without it, the chips have no remove button.

clear-label.constraint: The accessible name of the clear target of search, already localized. Without it, the field draws no clear target.

empty-heading.constraint: The title of the nph-empty when items is empty.

empty-description.constraint: The description of the nph-empty when items is empty.

no-result-heading.constraint: The title of the nph-empty when the search finds nothing.

no-result-description.constraint: The description of the nph-empty when the search finds nothing.

error-text.constraint: The phrase of the error row of a branch that failed to load, already localized.

retry-text.constraint: The action of the error row, already localized, such as "Try again".

open.constraint: The panel is open. The piece opens and closes it; the consumer may set it. Opening and closing fire no event. A disabled field does not open.

name.constraint: The name of the entries in the form data: one name=id in single and search, one per checked item in multiple, as a select multiple. Reflects because the form reads the attribute of the host. With no name, nothing is submitted.

required.constraint: With nothing chosen, the piece is valueMissing, with the message of the browser. nph-field writes it.

disabled.constraint: The whole piece at state/disabled-opacity, on color/muted, out of the Tab order and of the form data; it does not open. A disabled fieldset disables it too. It wins over invalid.

invalid.constraint: The error state: the border becomes status/error and the field gets aria-invalid. The sentence belongs to nph-field.

label.constraint: The accessible name in text, never visible, for a field with no associated label; nph-field writes it. An associated label wins over it.

description.constraint: The accessible description in text, never visible: the help or the error sentence that nph-field writes.

input.constraint: Fired by the host when the person changes the value: an item chosen, an item checked or unchecked, or a chip removed. It bubbles and crosses shadow roots. Typing does not fire it.

change.constraint: Fired by the host right after input. It bubbles. Setting value, values, query or open from code fires neither event.

nph-tree-toggle.constraint: With the detail of nph-tree, { id, expanded }, when the person opens or closes a branch in the panel. It bubbles and is composed.

nph-tree-load.constraint: With the detail of nph-tree, { id, retry }: a branch with no loaded children asks for them when it opens, once, and Try again on its error row asks again. The page loads the children and replaces items.

mode.choose_when: single for one item; search for one item in a large tree; multiple for several items or whole branches.
do_not_combine_with: multiple when the field takes one item only.

size.choose_when: default in most forms; large when the form uses tall fields. One size per form.
do_not_combine_with: default and large fields in the same form.

counter.choose_when: The chips in most forms; counter when the field must stay on one line, as in a filter or a toolbar.
do_not_combine_with: counter where the person needs to check each choice.

default.changes_for_user: The resting border, on color/background, with the start icon and the arrow in color/muted-foreground.

hover.changes_for_user: The border goes one step darker under the pointer.

focus.changes_for_user: Focus on the field: the border takes focus/border with the focus/halo attached outside.

open.changes_for_user: The panel is open and the field keeps the focus border; in multiple, open is the focus with the chips.

error.changes_for_user: The border is status/error, also on hover; the sentence is in nph-field.

error-focus.changes_for_user: The border stays status/error and the halo is focus/halo-error.

disabled.changes_for_user: The whole piece at state/disabled-opacity on color/muted; it keeps the value and the chips, does not open and wins over the error.

business_rules: DOM focus stays on the field while the panel is open; the active item is the treeitem the field points to by aria-activedescendant.
On opening, the active item is the chosen one, with the path to it open; with no value, the first item.
Hover paints an item and does not move the active item; with both on one item, the focus wins.
single and search: Enter, a click or Alt+ArrowUp choose the item and close the panel; choosing the same item fires nothing.
multiple: Enter or a click checks or unchecks the item and the panel stays open; the typed text is cleared and the item stays active.
A click on the chevron only opens or closes the branch; the rest of the row chooses or checks.
Checking a parent checks its enabled children; a parent with part checked is mixed; a disabled item stays out of the count.

A whole branch checked is one chip, the parent's; removing that chip unchecks the branch; values carries the parent and the items under it. With icons on, the chip repeats the folder or the file of its item; with icons off it has no icon.
Typing in search and multiple filters the tree, keeps the ancestors of every match visible and open, and makes the first match active.

A letter in single (D-1): closed, it opens the panel on the next visible item after the chosen one that starts with it; open, it moves the active item; the search wraps, the same letter cycles, a Space inside a quick search is part of it; the value changes only by Enter, Space outside a search, or Alt+ArrowUp.
Esc closes the panel with the focus on the field; closed with typed text, it clears the text. Tab closes without choosing and the focus moves on. A press outside closes and keeps the value.
The whole label of a cut item shows in an nph-tooltip: on hover after motion/hover-delay, and at once for the active item when the keyboard put it there, since the focus stays on the field.
A branch that opens with no children asks for them once with nph-tree-load; the spinner takes the place of the chevron. On a failed branch the error row says so and Enter tries again.
With no room below the panel opens above, at the same distance; above layout/max-list-height the tree scrolls inside the panel.
domain_errors: invalid: the choice needs correction, such as a required field with nothing chosen; nph-field writes the sentence and passes it as description.

tokens.height: control/height-default or control/height-large; in multiple a minimum that grows with the lines of chips
tokens.border: border/width, in color/input, color/input-hover, focus/border or status/error
tokens.padding: space/control-padding on the sides; space/inline-tight above and below in multiple
tokens.gap: space/inline between the parts; space/inline-tight between the chips and the text
tokens.icons: nph-icon globe, magnifying-glass, chevron-down, chevron-up and xmark, icon/size-sm in color/muted-foreground
tokens.arrow_area: color/accent, with the color/border divider; color/muted when disabled
tokens.text: text/body-md in color/foreground; the placeholder in color/muted-foreground
tokens.chip: color/primary-surface, radius/full, horizontal padding space/inline, gap space/inline-tight; the label text/label-sm in color/primary-on-surface; with icons, the nph-icon of the item at icon/size-sm
tokens.panel_width: tree-select/panel-width in single and search; tree-select/panel-width-multiple in multiple; the field width when it is larger
tokens.tree: tree/* of nph-tree: tree/padding around the rows, tree/item-height, tree/indent, the focus of the item; the balloon of a cut label is the nph-tooltip

ai_hints: Use nph-tree-select when the choice depends on the place of the item in a hierarchy; for a list with no levels, nph-select or nph-combobox.
Put nph-tree-select inside nph-field, which gives the label, the help text and the error message.
Give the data as items, never as children; set value (single, search) or values (multiple) as ids.
Pick search for a large tree and multiple for several items; pick counter only when the field must stay on one line.
Always set remove-label in multiple and clear-label in search, the localized words of the two buttons.
Answer nph-tree-load by replacing items, as with nph-tree.
Let the field take the width of the form; the panel takes the width of the field.
Read the value from the host on input or change, or from the form data under its name.
Never use the placeholder as the only name.

accessibility.semantics: The APG combobox with a tree popup. The field has role combobox (the text field in search and multiple, the field itself in single), aria-haspopup tree, aria-expanded and aria-controls. The panel is role tree, aria-multiselectable in multiple, aria-busy on the first load; each item is a treeitem with aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset, aria-expanded on a branch, aria-selected in single and search, aria-checked (mixed on a mixed parent) in multiple, aria-disabled on a disabled item and aria-busy on a branch that loads. Icons are hidden from the screen reader. The host is form-associated and labelable.
accessibility.accessible_name: From the label associated with the host, else from label; the whole path of the chosen item (such as Documents, Contracts, Contract 2025.pdf) follows it in the name of the field in single and search, because the field shows only the label of the item. The tree has the same name. The placeholder is not a name. Each remove button is named by remove-label and the item it removes.
keyboard: Closed, single: Enter, Space, ArrowDown, ArrowUp and Alt+ArrowDown open on the chosen item or the first; Home and End open on the first and the last; a letter opens on the next item that starts with it.
Closed, search: ArrowDown and ArrowUp open on the chosen item, else on the first or the last; typing opens and filters; Alt+ArrowDown opens with no active item until the person moves.
Closed, multiple: ArrowDown and ArrowUp open on the first or the last; typing opens and filters; Alt+ArrowDown opens with no active item until the person moves.
Open: ArrowDown and ArrowUp move between the visible items; ArrowRight opens a closed branch or goes to its first child; ArrowLeft closes an open branch or goes to the parent.

Open, single: Home and End go to the first and the last item; the asterisk opens the siblings of the level; a letter moves to the next item that starts with it; Enter, Space or Alt+ArrowUp choose and close.

Open, search: Enter or Alt+ArrowUp choose and close; Home, End and Space are typed in the field. Open, multiple: Enter checks and unchecks and keeps the panel open; Alt+ArrowUp closes without choosing.
Esc closes with the focus on the field; Tab closes without choosing and the focus moves on.
accessibility.focus: DOM focus does not leave the field while the panel is open. The active item draws the focus border of the nph-tree item by a state, when the last input was the keyboard, with no DOM focus on it. The field shows the focus border and the halo while it has the focus and while the panel is open. On a click outside, focus goes where the person clicked.
accessibility.contrast: The text of the field, the chips and the items meet 4.5:1 in both themes; the border of the field meets 3:1. The outline of the panel is decorative: the elevation/dropdown shadow and the background separate the layer. The skeleton is decorative. The disabled field is exempt.
accessibility.color_alternative: The chosen item has a bar at the start and the weight of the label, besides the background; a parent with part checked shows a dash in the box; the error is said by the sentence of nph-field.

invalid_combinations: A mode outside single, search and multiple — the field draws nothing.
A size outside default and large — the field draws nothing.
items with a repeated id or a node with no label — the field draws nothing.
Chips without remove-label — no remove button.
counter without subject — the counter alone.
invalid without the sentence in nph-field — red with no text.
anti_patterns: Using it for a list with no levels.
Using it to explore items without filling a field.
Using multiple for a single choice.
Making the panel narrower than the field of the mode.
Putting the field on the screen without nph-field and a label.
